profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Principle Software Engineer, I spent my early career working on a mainframe and the IBMi(AS/400, iSeries, etc) and then spent the last several years on the web learning those technologies. I am now enjoying a reentry to the IBMi. 

Skilled in JavaScript, RPGLE, SQL, CLP, Java and C#. Learning AI as quickly as possible.
